description: Tools for kefche's moderators and admins.
failed: The admin panel couldn't load. Check your connection and try again.
staffOnlyBody: This part of kefche is for its moderators and admins.
adminOnly: Only admins can open this section.
pending: This section isn't ready yet. It arrives in a later update.

audit.actorHint: A nickname or an account id.

actions.announcementUntick: Announcement taken out of the news
actions.dailyClear: Daily challenge back to the rotation

players.queryHint: Part of a nickname, or an account id.
players.queryHintAdmin: Part of a nickname or an email address, or an account id.
players.notFound: There's no account with this id.

act.title: Actions
act.resetNicknameBody: They get a name like player_123456 and can choose a new one straight away. They're told it was reset.
act.resetAvatarBody: Their initials show instead, and an uploaded picture can't be chosen again. They're told it was removed.
act.resetBioBody: Their bio is removed. They're told it was cleared.
act.sanctionBody: The player is told the sanction, its reason and when it ends.
act.noteHint: For the record, up to 500 characters.
act.roleBody: For {name}. The panel changes at once; elsewhere it takes up to an hour.
act.deleteBody: For a deletion request. They're signed out now, and the usual purge deletes the account and its data within the hour. Until then, you can cancel.

errors.adminOnly: Only an admin can do that.
errors.rateLimited: Too many actions. Wait a few minutes.
errors.lastAdmin: The last admin can't be removed.

reports.empty: No open reports. All caught up.
reports.contextEmpty: The conversation is no longer there.
reports.contextDm: Reading a direct message's conversation is recorded in the audit log.
reports.dismissBody: Anything hidden comes back, and the reports close.

removeBody.message: The message is deleted for everyone, and the reports close.
removeBody.user: Their bio is cleared and stays off, and the reports close. To change a nickname, reset it from the player's page.
removeBody.avatar: The avatar stays off, and the reports close.

reports.sanctionBody: What was reported is removed too, and the player is told the sanction, its reason and when it ends.
reports.bulkBody: This applies to every selected item ({count}).
reports.partial: Some of them didn't go through. Try again.

chat.queryHint: Part of a message, as typed. Direct messages can't be searched.
chat.senderHint: A nickname or an account id.
chat.deleteBody: Its text is erased for everyone. The deletion is recorded in the audit log.
chat.slowBody: How long each player waits between messages in a global room.
chat.unmuteBody: They can chat again at once, and the revoke is recorded in the audit log.

games.settingsBody: Turned off, a game can't be started anywhere: new games, rooms, matchmaking and arenas. Games already under way finish. Pages show the change once they load.
games.offNote: Saving turns the game off for everyone at once.
games.positionHint: 1 comes first. Empty: the catalog's own order.
games.closeBody: Everyone in it is told the room closed, and it's deleted with its chat. This can't be undone.

integrity.reviewBody: Results whose moves didn't replay, or whose players reported different endings. Accepted, one counts in the players' stats and XP; its rating change and board places aren't added afterwards. Rejected, it counts for nothing.
integrity.matchBody: Any match by its id, from a player's page. A counted result found to be cheated can be annulled.
integrity.matchIdHint: From a player's page in the panel.
integrity.matchNotFound: There's no match with this id.
integrity.boardsBody: A board's best results. Removing one leaves the player's next result to set a new best.
integrity.boardEmpty: Nobody is on this board yet.
integrity.removeEntryBody: Their place on this board and period is removed. Their next result sets a new best.
integrity.playerBody: Their ratings and their places on each game's boards.
integrity.playerHint: A nickname or an account id.
integrity.playerNotFound: No player has this nickname or id.
integrity.resetRatingBody: They start again at 1500 ± 350 with no games, as a new player. Their past matches stay.
integrity.resetBoardsBody: Every place they hold on this game's boards, all time and weekly, is removed.
integrity.acceptBody: It counts in each player's stats, XP and streak, as if it had replayed.
integrity.rejectBody: It's kept for the record and counts for nothing.
integrity.annulBody: It stops counting: the XP it gave is taken back and the board places it set are removed. Play counts and best scores in the players' stats stay.
integrity.annulRated: Ratings stay as they are; reset a player's rating if it needs to start again.

errors.invalidAnnouncement: Check it: English is needed, each text is at most 500 characters, the link is a path on this site, and the times are in the future.
errors.alreadySent: It was sent meanwhile, so it can't change.
errors.invalid: That can't be saved. Check the day and try again.

content.announcementsBody: Sent as a notification to every player in the audience, page and push, whatever their settings. Optionally also shown in the news on the home page.
content.textHint: English is required. A player whose language is missing reads English. Up to 500 characters each.
content.fallback: Not written in this language: it falls back to English.
content.urlHint: A path on this site, like /en/games/reversi/.
content.ticker: Also show it in the news on the home page
content.tickerUntilHint: Empty: until you take it out.
content.deleteBody: It hasn't been sent, so nobody gets it.
content.untickTitle: Take it out of the news?
content.untickBody: It leaves the home page. The notifications stay with the players who got them.
content.dailyBody: The next two weeks (days start at 00:00 UTC). A future day can be set to another game from the rotation, with its settings.
content.dayLocked: Today's can't change: players may have played it.
content.wordsBody: Each language's word for a day (UTC), from today. Without one, the home page shows no word card.
content.noWords: No words for the next 30 days.
content.removeWordBody: The home page shows no word in that language that day.
content.achievementsBody: Read-only: each game's manifest defines its achievements, and they change with a deploy. Content packs come later (Phase 15).
content.sendBody: It goes at once to {audience}, as a notification. It can't be taken back.

i18n.summaryBody: From the locale files as they were when the site was built. Translations change in the repository, not here.
i18n.sameBody: Often not translated yet; sometimes rightly the same, like a name or “GIF”.
i18n.filterHint: Part of a key or a text.
